items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: my good friend George Perilli who we ended up playing for years... And he was in the band so it was fantastic.

ctx.x: No, we had, I think we had, well I got a cassette of a live show so I went to the woodshed with that. And then I think we had two or three days of rehearsal with the full band out at a place called The Power Plant, which was a big rehearsal facility. And the first gig I did with him was at the Delmar Racetrack down towards San Diego. And I’ve got to say, man, it was a night I will never forget. A) I’ve never played — up to that point I don’t think I’d played in a band that was quite that loud. But it was super…
Now do those type of guys use different players in the studio than they do live?
